notes.title: DirectX 11 Non-Ray Tracing Version Now Available
notes.content:
Hello Resident Evil fans,

Due to overwhelming community response, we've reactivated the previous version that does not include ray tracing and enhanced 3D audio. Both enhanced and previous versions will be made available going forward.

Please follow the steps below if you wish to roll back to the previous version.

1. Click LIBRARY in Steam client.
2. Right-click the game and select ""Properties...""
3. In the pop-up menu, select ""BETAS""
4. From the pull-down menu, select ""dx11_non-rt"" (Note: password not required)
5. Close the pop-up menu and let the Steam client auto-update the game
6. You should be able to launch the game normally once the update completes
7. Please note some of the in-game option settings will be reset as a result of the rollback process.

If you would like to update the game to the new version again, simply select ""None"" from the pull-down menu in Step 4 above.

Resident Evil Team

notes.title: (Text updated)Update on system requirements
notes.content:
An upgrade patch will be releasing soon and system requirements will also be updated.

【Update on system requirements】
The system requirements will change with the arrival of the upgrade patch. The new minimum requirements are listed below alongside the previous specifications no longer supported under this upgrade patch.

Minimum requirements:
■OS
Before：WINDOWS® 7, 8, 8.1, 10 (64-BIT Required)
After：WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)

■DirectX
Before：Version 11
After：Version 12

■Graphics
Before：
NVIDIA® GeForce® GeForce GTX 760
or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x
After：
NVIDIA® GeForce® GeForce GTX 960
or AMD Radeon™ RX 460

【How to toggle automatic updates OFF】
Follow the following steps before the patch goes live.

1. Right-click the title under your Library, and select "Properties..."
2. In the "UPDATES" tab, change Automatic Updates to "Update only when I launch it"
3. Press "Steam" in your steam client, and select "Go Offline"
4. Press "Play" to start the game.

※Please switch to "Go Offline" every time you play this title.
※Please be aware that once the upgrade patch has been applied, the game cannot be restored to the previous version even if the game is uninstalled.

notes.title: Upgrade patches coming for three Resident Evil masterpieces
notes.content:
Resident Evil 2, Resident Evil 3 and Resident Evil 7 biohazard return in 2022 with cutting–edge features including ray tracing, high frame rate and 3D audio for an enhanced gameplay experience(*).

Existing owners of these titles will receive an upgrade patch at no additional cost. 

Stay tuned for more informaton in the future.

* No new gameplay content will be added.

notes.title: Resident Evil 7 PC Demo out on Dec. 19th, 2016
notes.content:
Hello Resident Evil fans,

Thanks for your patience as we prepare the PC demo for Resident Evil 7 biohazard; it’s right around the corner! Just to let you know, the team has been working very hard behind the scenes spending extra care and love in optimizing the PC demo to ensure an awesome experience for our PC fans.

While we still have a couple more weeks to go before the PC demo release, we’d like to show you a glimpse of what you can expect under the graphics option menu.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25347158/d24b1846ec75261be1369604b7a247a0c4890d10.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Graphics Options:[/b][/h1][list]
[*][b]Screen Resolution[/b]…self-explanatory here, but the game will list arbitrary resolutions supported by your monitor and Windows desktop environment.
[*][b]Refresh Rate[/b]…adjustable to frequencies supported by your monitor.  Also supports 144Hz high refresh monitors including Nvidia G-Sync.
[*][b]Display Mode[/b]…Full screen, Windowed [strike],and Borderless Window[/strike] modes are supported. (*Borderless Window mode removed from demo due to a last-minute bug.  To be fixed and added in the final product.)
[*][b]Field of View[/b]…FOV angle can be adjusted here
[*][b]Frame Rate[/b]…supports 30, 60, and Variable (uncapped)
[*][b]V-Sync[/b]…ON/OFF
[*][b]Rendering Method[/b]…Two options available - Normal and Interlaced
[*][b]Resolution Scaling[/b]…controls the game’s internal rendering resolution. This is akin to upscaling and downsampling of the final video output. Selectable option ranges from 0.5X to 2.0X. 1.0X is 100% 1:1 native output. The higher the number, the better the image quality and more GPU ‘oomph’ required, while lowering it below 1.0 makes the image softer (but also reduces GPU overhead and increases frame rate).
[*][b]Texture Quality[/b]…option ranges from Very Low to Very High.  Higher quality requires additional local video memory.
[*][b]Texture Filtering[/b]…option ranges from Very Low to Very High.  Internally, this is essentially your Trilinear to Anisotropic filter that goes all the way up to 16X.
[*][b]Mesh Quality[/b]…option ranges between Low to Very High.  This option also affects Level-of-Detail (LOD) quality.
[*][b]Anti-Aliasing[/b]…Selectable options include FXAA, TAA, FXAA+TAA, and SMAA.
[*][b]Motion Blur[/b]…ON/OFF toggle
[*][b]Effects Rendering[/b]…Selectable between Low, Medium and High.  This controls the intensity and density of certain visual effects.
[*][b]Depth of Field[/b]…ON/OFF toggle
[*][b]Shadow Quality[/b]…option ranges from Very Low to Very High.
[*][b]Dynamic Shadows[/b]…ON/OFF toggle 
[*][b]Shadow Cache[/b]…ON/OFF toggle. When set to ON, shadows for static objects will be cached in video memory.
[*][b]Ambient Occlusion[/b]…Selectable options include OFF, SSAO (Variable), SSAO, and  [url=http://www.geforce.com/hardware/technology/hbao-plus/technology]HBAO+[/url].
[*][b]Bloom Effect[/b]…ON/OFF toggle
[*][b]Lens Flare[/b]…ON/OFF toggle
[*][b]Volumetric Lighting Quality[/b]…Selectable between OFF, Low, and High.  This option controls intensity and quality of dynamic lighting including light shafts piercing through window panes and vents.
[*][b]Reflections[/b]…Selectable between ON, OFF, and Variable.  Affects fidelity and quality of screen-space reflections.
[*][b]Subsurface Scattering[/b]…ON/OFF toggle
[*][b]Chromatic Aberration[/b]…ON/OFF toggle
[*][b]Color Space[/b]…Selectable between SRGB and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rec._709]BT.709[/url]
[/list]
That’s all for now, but you can also look forward to other PC-specific customization options we haven’t covered here in the upcoming PC Demo launching on December 19th.

Resident Evil Team
